Limitless Christian Fellowship

Brand System, Weekly Content & Digital Direction · Faith Community, Stafford, Texas
Timeline
2026–Present
Engagement
Ongoing weekly retainer
Deliverables
13 deliverable types

Limitless Christian Fellowship is a faith community in Stafford, Texas. It is intended to welcome people across nations, ethnicities, and socioeconomic backgrounds through the love of God demonstrated by Christ.

The Problem

The fellowship was growing but lacked a coherent, modern, minimalist communications system. It needed to feel welcoming, spiritually grounded, youthful, multicultural, contemporary, community-led, energetic, reverent, and accessible.

The Strategic Move

Build a flexible identity that works consistently across changing weekly communication needs, without becoming repetitive.

What We Built
  • Brand strategy
  • Logo and mark
  • Colour and typography system
  • Brand guidelines
  • Social-media templates
  • Instagram launch/introduction carousel
  • Sermon-screen and livestream graphics
  • Event flyers
  • Service announcements
  • YouTube thumbnails
  • Website / landing-page UI/UX direction
  • Video editing
  • Content instruction and content ideas

This is an ongoing contract started in 2026. Weekly support includes YouTube thumbnails, Instagram posts, TikTok engagement content, video editing, and creative direction.

Outcome

Every Thursday since May 2026 has run on one system: 20 YouTube thumbnails, 4 flyers and the livestream graphics, delivered weekly to the church's media team.
